summary: Frontend-only testing of new blog article detail page (/blog/:id). Verified blog listing navigation (featured + card), article rendering (hero, body, h2, quote, share, Faire un don, related), back-to-blog, direct navigation, invalid id (article-not-found), and mobile viewport. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ArticleBlog.jsx: consider adding a scroll-to-top on route change; navigating between articles preserves scroll position which can feel jarring.
Article-not-found link back to /blog has no data-testid; test used href selector as workaround (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog->article navigation fully works. Featured (blog-featured) and cards (blog-card-{i}) route to /blog/:id. ArticleBlog renders article-page with 2 h2 (including subheading) and 1 blockquote pull-quote. Share buttons show 'Partage' toast (sonner). Related articles link to /blog/{id}. Invalid ids render article-not-found with a Retour au blog link. Tested on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844, zero console errors.
